3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The sound of cracking glass rang through the room as the skylight above shattered.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: With ruthless efficiency, the men of Palantor Security Solutions descended on ropes, landing with a series of solid thuds. They moved like clockwork.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: The guards, unprepared for the ambush, were overwhelmed. Shots rang out, and two of them crumpled to the floor, dead before they could react.

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: Titus, wielding his sidearm, managed to take down an operative before jumping behind a serving trolley.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: With quick steps, the armed men encircled the table, pointing their weapons toward my guests.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: One of the men approached the table. He methodically collected the scattered papers and spread them out neatly before the trembling nobles.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: No shots came from the Golden Guard. Instead, one by one, they were subdued.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: An operative approached Titus from behind and disarmed him with a swift strike, slamming him against the wall before pinning him to the ground. The remaining guards lay scattered across the floor.

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "If you value your lives, you'll sign these papers without hesitation."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Sign the papers, and I promise your concerns will still be heard. My only wish is for a peaceful compromise."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "You have my sincerest apologies. I never wanted it to come to this."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "I told you there wasn't way out of this. I can no longer stand by and allow the people of this country to be oppressed by the nobility."

33.text: "Romus -- Your Majesty. This has gone too far."

56.text: "Just sign it, Hugo. I've got no quarrel with you."

64.text: "This isn't the way forward. But if I must..."

73.speaker: Angelica Sazon
73.text: "Is this how you plan to establish democracy -- by holding guns to our heads? You're no better than Lucas Sazon."

77.speaker: Manus Sazon
77.text: "Your Majesty! Please! There's no need for threats of violence. House Sazon will sign."
77.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_AzaroSigned"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true)

79.text: He grabbed the pen and signed the papers.

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Hey! Get those guns away from my family!"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Just sign it, Hugo. And we won't have any problems."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "Lower your guns! Hugo knows better than to resist."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: "While we're at it, let's make it unanimous."

99.text: "House Azaro, I am awaiting your signatures."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I told you. Nobody's going anywhere until I get your signatures."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "All that's needed is your signature, General, and there won't be any trouble."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "I'm afraid I cannot let you go until these reforms are implemented."

115.speaker: Hugo Toras
115.text: "Romus! Order these men to stand down!"

117.speaker: Hugo Toras
117.text: "I'm doing as the king says. For the sake of peace, and our family's safety."

119.speaker: Player_Romus
119.text: "Please sign and leave, Hugo. I have no quarrels with you."

120.speaker: Player_Romus
120.text: "Hey! Get those guns away from my family!"

121.speaker: Narrator
121.text: They lowered their rifles on my command. Hugo took a step forward.

124.speaker: Hugo Toras
124.text: "I warned you about him! I did everything I could to keep him from manipulating you."

125.speaker: Hugo Toras
125.text: "Not only did you let him into our family, but now, because of him, we have guns pointed at us!"

129.speaker: Hugo Toras
129.text: "He’s the one who got you to point a gun at your own family."

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: He stretched his arms wide, a gesture that only prompted the soldiers to press their guns harder against him.

131.speaker: Hugo Toras
131.text: "Where is that Sazon boy? Your partner in crime!"

135.speaker: Manus Sazon
135.text: "I... I have nothing to do with this."

146.speaker: Leona Sazon
146.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false)

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "He has nothing to do with this. I organized this on my own."
148.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false)

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: Manus tried to convince me otherwise, but unlike him, I know that force is the only language people like you understand."
149.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false)

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "Keep pushing me and I'll make you regret it. I won't say it again."
150.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false)

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "It seems you don't fully realize the gravity of the situation you're in."
151.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true) == false)

161.speaker: Vina Toras
161.text: "Manus! Was this part of your plan?"

163.speaker: Lucita Azaro
163.text: "This is a coup! Plain and simple!"

168.text: "There is nothing to gain from fighting. Please just cooperate."
168.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Vina"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_TorasSigned"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false)

169.speaker: Manus Sazon
169.text: "No! I swear, I had nothing to do with it."

175.speaker: Angelica Sazon
175.text: "If there's no other way out, then so be it."

189.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
189.text: "Make no mistake, this is a coup!"
189.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_AzaroSigned"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_AzaroSigned"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Carlos"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_AzaroSigned"] == false)

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: The Palantor guards retracted their weapons from the nobles' heads.

207.speaker: Player_Romus
207.text: "Now, that wasn't so difficult, was it?"

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "This was the only way to truly transform our monarchy. I'm sure you'll understand one day."

210.speaker: Russello Montoro
210.text: "Oh, don't mind me. I'm just making sure my team executed everything properly. Pretend like I'm not even here."

211.speaker: Narrator
211.text: I realized that, amid the mayhem of what had just transpired, Rusty had slipped into the room.

213.speaker: Hugo Toras
213.text: "Never one to care for this kingdom, loyalty, or anything beyond your own gain."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "I think it's best you step out, Rusty. The room is no place for a spectator."

215.speaker: Player_Romus
215.text: "As you can see, your men performed with the utmost proficiency and skill."

216.speaker: Player_Romus
216.text: "If you're going to pretend you're not here, Rusty, why not do it somewhere else?"

218.speaker: Russello Montoro
218.text: "Fine, fine, I'll head out. Don’t miss me too much."

220.speaker: Narrator
220.text: He walked up to Manus and put an arm around his shoulder.

224.speaker: Hugo Toras
224.text: "Mr. Montoro. I can't say I'm surprised."

226.speaker: Narrator
226.text: He flashed a grin at Manus and followed it with a mocking curtsy.

231.speaker: Russello Montoro
231.text: "No need to thank your old pal."

232.speaker: Russello Montoro
232.text: "Looking forward to waking up in a new Rizia."

236.speaker: Russello Montoro
236.text: "By the way, I had a word with Prime Minister Sazon."

237.speaker: Russello Montoro
237.text: "We must get to work immediately, Mr. Prime Minister. I'm just brimming with ideas for the new administration."

238.speaker: Player_Romus
238.text: "She and Leona can leave. We already have House Sazon's full support."
238.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_SazonSigned"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_SazonSigned"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == true)

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I'm afraid you'll be placed under strict surveillance until the reforms are implemented and your House fully cooperates with the new government."

244.speaker: Player_Romus
244.text: "Hello Rusty. We were just wrapping this up."

245.speaker: Russello Montoro
245.text: "And besides, I think the King wants a private word with these troublemakers."

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: On Rusty's command, several armed men approached and escorted them out.

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING!? MY DAUGHTER IS IN THE ROOM!"

263.speaker: Narrator
263.text: After they had left, the remaining contract soldiers seized the other guests by their arms.

264.speaker: Narrator
264.text: Their commander, Antoine, turned to me, awaiting my orders.

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "She stays. I can't risk her trying to stop these reforms before they're set in motion."
269.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_SazonSigned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == true) == false)

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "I'm afraid I can't let her go after what happened."
270.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ReformTalks_ViolentPlanB"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_SazonSigned"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_ReformTalk_Sazon_Supports"] == true) == false)

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: On Rusty's command, several of the armed men approached and escorted the Sazons out.

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "By the authority vested in me as the King of Rizia, I place you all under arrest."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "Hugo. I know you were the first to step up and give your signature. Tell me. Can I trust you to help with these reforms?"

276.speaker: Narrator
276.text: Lucita's face twisted with disgust as she glared at me.

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: General Taddeus furrowed his brow as he glanced around the room.

281.speaker: Player_Romus
281.text: "I’m afraid you’ll be placed under strict surveillance until the reforms are implemented and your House fully cooperates with the new government."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "By the authority vested in me as the King of Rizia, I place you all under arrest."

284.speaker: Manus Sazon
284.text: "You promised not to touch my family!"

288.speaker: Russello Montoro
288.text: "It was his request that I ensure the safety of his family."

292.speaker: Narrator
292.text: He walked up to Leona and put an arm around her shoulder. She smiled uncomfortably.

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: On Rusty's command, several of the armed men approached and escorted them out.

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: He walked up to Angelica and put an arm around her shoulder. Her lips curled in revulsion.

296.speaker: Russello Montoro
296.text: "May I escort her out, Your Majesty?"

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "No. I'm afraid I can't let the Sazons go. I can't take any chances."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "Yes. Both she and Leona can leave."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "I expected this to be quick and discreet. Not a firefight breaking out with my daughter in the room."

305.speaker: Russello Montoro
305.text: "The Golden Guard are no joke, Your Majesty."

306.speaker: Russello Montoro
306.text: "But it seems like everything's under control to me."

309.speaker: Russello Montoro
309.text: "Mr. Prime Minister will be quite disappointed."

310.speaker: Russello Montoro
310.text: "Anyway, Your Majesty, I'll leave you to it."

311.speaker: Narrator
311.text: After he'd left, the remaining contract soldiers seized the other guests by their arms.

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: He took several of the armed men with him and walked to the door.

313.speaker: Hugo Toras
313.text: "I will not pretend I understand your actions today, nor that I am overjoyed by them."

314.speaker: Player_Romus
314.text: "That's not good enough, Hugo. Does that mean it's currently not aligned?"

315.speaker: Player_Romus
315.text: "Make sure our family stays out of this. You are free to go."

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "Thank you for saying that. However, I'm still not convinced you, Rico, or Hubertus can be trusted."

324.speaker: Rico Toras
324.text: "Your mercy will be remembered, King Romus."

330.speaker: Lucita Azaro
330.text: "Promised? So the Sazons were in on this?!"

331.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
331.text: "Promised? The Sazons will pay for this."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "I'm sorry, Manus. I'm not taking any chances."

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "Don't worry. Nobody's going to get harmed."

336.speaker: Player_Romus
336.text: "Rusty. You and Mr. Sazon may leave."

340.speaker: Narrator
340.text: On Rusty's command, several of the armed men grabbed Manus and took him out.

341.speaker: Player_Romus
341.text: "Hold up, Rico. I didn't say *you* could go."

345.speaker: Player_Romus
345.text: "I'm sorry, but that's too big of a risk for me to take."

346.speaker: Hugo Toras
346.text: "Please. I give my word that House Toras poses no threat to you."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "Fine. Make sure our family stays out of this. You are free to go."

349.speaker: Hubertus Toras
349.text: "His Grace is correct. House Toras is completely behind you and your reforms, Your Majesty."

353.speaker: Rico Toras
353.text: "I pose no danger to you nor to the reforms."

354.speaker: Narrator
354.text: Hugo's jaw dropped, his eyes frozen in a look of pure astonishment.

355.speaker: Player_Romus
355.text: "I'm afraid you will be placed under strict surveillance until the reforms are implemented, and your House demonstrates full cooperation with the new government."

356.speaker: Player_Romus
356.text: "With the authority vested upon me as the King of Rizia, I place you all under arrest."
